# Lint premise rows for the shadow selector (tests/harness/src/test_dev_shadow_select.c).
# One row per corpus entry and per gate that declares a premise in
#   rebased onto main as 0868432a3e, whose tree differs only in docs/CAPABILITY_INVENTORY.jsonl.
# check-windows-acceptance rows: z23-lint built from b089f792ba (lane winacc-split),
#   run the same way on the same entries and bases, measured 2026-09-25; the six
#   older gates' counts in a combined run with that binary equal the rows above
# check-doc-claims rows: z23-lint built from b47b449e4e (lane docclaims-split),
#   (reproduced byte-identical on a second host), run the same way on the same
#   entries and bases, measured 2026-09-25; the seven older gates' counts in a
#   combined run with that binary equal the rows above on all 28 entries
#   (196 of 196). always_ms=2100 is the measured --global part with
#   driver-recorded oracle verdicts (max of three cold-cache runs, 2.06 s).
# One run per entry and gate, measured 2026-09-25:
# syn rows: candidate = `git archive 7a9f354f3f` plus <id>.patch, base = 7a9f354f3f.
# The base was verified through https://github.com/z23c/z23.git (Landlock on).
# select_ms is the wall time of that one run (make unit listing, private
# fetch, hashing and closure); units and fresh are the summary's counts.
# always_ms is the part of the gate that runs whatever selection says (0 for
# the six per-TU and per-file gates). check-windows-acceptance: its global
# part (self-test 1.25 s CPU, reconcile 0.08 s, make -n 0.48 s) plus the
# private sqlite archive the four always-fresh rows link (16.33 s CPU), 18.14 s.
